questions.q: Why plan ahead instead of waiting for the return?
questions.a: Strategic tax planning is usually the only opportunity taxpayers have to control (within the boundaries of the law) the amount of income taxes they'll pay in a given year. You can decide how, when and where to invest or spend money in the future, but you cannot change the results of the past: a tax return is simply a receipt of transactions that have already occurred.

questions.q: How long do I have to respond?
questions.a: Tax debt resolution is an urgent matter, as the IRS or State only allows a specified amount of time to respond to various tax notices prior to taking further actions. Most individuals and businesses end up facing large tax balances because they did not have a licensed tax professional to help them avoid these pitfalls.

services.lead: Our levy, lien, and penalty relief service is designed to help taxpayers who have received urgent notices from the IRS. Our team of CPAs and attorneys have the experience and knowledge to help you understand your options and work to resolve any levies, liens, or penalties you may be facing.

questions.q: Why are levies and liens so urgent?
questions.a: Levies and liens are the most time sensitive issues you can face from the IRS or State. Imagine getting an alert from your bank stating your savings has been wiped out by the IRS, or planning to use your entire paycheck but the IRS has taken 25% of it. These IRS enforcement actions usually happen unannounced and are painful.

services.lead: Our IRS Audit Representation service ensures that you have the best chance of success when facing an IRS audit. We provide expertise and experience to help you navigate the complexities of the audit process and provide strategies for mitigating any potential penalties. Our team of certified public accountants will work closely with you to ensure you are fully prepared and represented throughout the audit.

questions.q: What can an audit actually change?
questions.a: The IRS has the power to disallow deductions and credits, while increasing your income as a part of the audit process, leaving you responsible to pay any additional taxes, penalties, and interest as a result of their adjustments. Retaining our experienced professionals makes sure the IRS isn't conveniently forgetting to apply sections of the tax code that will work to your benefit.

facts.heading: What we ask when you get in touch
items: A tax planning request asks for your taxpayer type, how your business is treated for tax purposes, your previous year's income tax expense, your current tax advisor and the topic of interest or concern.
A tax debt request asks for the type of tax debt, roughly how much you owe and a description of the tax problem.
A general enquiry asks for your name, email, phone, the subject of concern and a description of the issue.
